title: Introduce stochastic cohort prober with graceful quarantine latch
author: Aisha N. Patel
description: Motivation: We see intermittent, low-signal regressions that only surface in small slices of user traffic and are masked by aggregate metrics. This PR adds a stochastic cohort prober that performs randomized targeted probes across semantic cohorts with tunable sampling tilt and an adaptive quarantine latch that gracefully isolates suspect cohorts while keeping the mainline CI green. Design summary: 1) Prober engine: lightweight probe scheduler that picks cohorts by a hybrid of recency and semantic rarity; sampling probability is configurable (beta-distribution tilt) so teams can favor rare/critical cohorts. 2) Scoring: each probe produces an anomaly score (error magnitude + surprise penalty) which is aggregated with exponentially weighted windows to avoid flips on single-shot noise. 3) Quarantine latch: when aggregated score for a cohort crosses a configurable soft threshold, we move that cohort to a quarantined probe-run mode (higher sampling and holdback) and emit a soft-fail signal to CI that can be configured to either block merges or create an automated rollback/alert. 4) Rollback connector: optional integration points to the rollback orchestration service (canary/rollback policies in Redwood Console). Compatibility: designed to work with existing eval-gate adapters and the smoke-eval webhook; no changes required to existing prompt-set definitions. Configuration: new top-level config block: "stochastic_prober" with subkeys for sampling_rate, tilt_alpha, warmup_windows, soft_threshold, hard_threshold, quarantine_policy (notify|block|rollback), and synthetic_probe_budget. Rollout plan: feature-gate off by default; roll out to a subset of monorepo consumers then enable per-team via config overrides. Tests: end-to-end harness includes deterministic mode for unit tests plus stochastic smoke runs in CI to validate statistical properties (see ci checks). Checklist: - [x] Prober scheduler implementation - [x] Aggregation and scoring primitives - [x] Quarantine latch + policy enum - [x] Unit tests for deterministic paths - [x] Integration smoke runs + CI hooks - [x] Documentation + config schema - [x] Migration guide and release notes Related: builds on ideas from ENG-6287 (anchor-driven probes) and complements the perturbation/synthetic-prober work; this PR intentionally focuses on probabilistic sampling and graceful quarantine semantics rather than adversarial perturbation generation.
commits_summary: 3 commits: (1) core: add stochastic prober scheduler, sampling utilities and config schema; (2) scoring: implement EWMA anomaly aggregator and thresholding; (3) infra: CI smoke matrix, migration docs, and rollback connector stub
review_thread: Marco: Overall +1, but we need clearer invariants on the EWMA half-life and a defensive cap on sampling budget. | Aisha: addressed in commit 2; added budget cap and explicit half-life config with reasonable defaults. | Jinsoo: requested an additional integration test that simulates a drifting cohort and verifies graceful quarantine vs hard rollback behavior. | Aisha: added a deterministic drift sim test and updated the quarantine_policy docs to clarify behavior. | Elena: flagged a potential race between the prober scheduler and concurrent cohort updates in the prompt-set registry; suggested a lock or versioned read. | Aisha: added versioned-read with optimistic checks, updated tests to exercise concurrent updates. | Marco: approved after final CI pass.
merge_outcome: squash and merge by Marco Ruiz; PR merged to main after green CI; release flagged for next minor
release_notes: Introduce a configurable stochastic cohort prober and graceful quarantine latch to detect low-signal regressions in targeted prompt cohorts. Off by default; enable via eval.stochastic_prober in config. See docs/eval-stochastic-prober.md for migration and tuning guidance.
notes_for_operators: Default sampling settings are conservative: sampling_rate=0.001, tilt_alpha=1.5, warmup_windows=5. Teams should start with notify quarantine_policy to observe signals before moving to block or rollback. Monitor eval.prober.sample_rate and eval.prober.quarantine_count metrics.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: increased eval noise and potential CI flakiness if stochastic sampling is wide-open. Mitigation: deterministic test mode for PR-level runs, conservative defaults, and quota/budget caps. Rollback path is opt-in and tested.
changelog_entry: Added stochastic cohort prober with EWMA-based anomaly scoring and quarantine latch (configurable).
